Base Channel.send_file defaults to False (no upload support) (base.py:54-60); the protection is meaningful only for channels implementing upload.

contracts.commit_point: sandbox_audit_middleware.py:172-204 — in wrap_tool_call, a 'block' verdict returns the error ToolMessage at line 183 before handler(request) at line 184; in awrap_tool_call, the block returns at line 200 before 'await handler(request)' at line 201, so the shell command never reaches execution.
contracts.declared_mechanism: SandboxAuditMiddleware (AgentMiddleware[ThreadState]) registered into the shared runtime middleware chain: for tool_call name == 'bash', _pre_process runs _classify_command (normalized regex scan of _HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS plus a shlex token re-scan; shlex ValueError -> block), writes a structured audit log entry, and on a 'block' verdict returns _build_block_message (ToolMessage with status='error') instead of calling handler; medium-risk commands pass with an appended warning note.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A 'bash' tool call whose command matches a high-risk pattern — rm with a recursive flag targeting /, /*, ~, /home, or /root; curl/wget piped into (ba)sh; 'dd if='; 'mkfs'; 'cat /etc/shadow'; output redirection into '/etc/' — or whose command fails shlex parsing (unclosed quotes treated as suspicious), reaching the bash tool handler for execution.

Ordering and interaction with SandboxMiddleware and GuardrailMiddleware in the same middleware list is not specified in supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Invocation of the bash tool handler for agent-issued tool calls named 'bash' dispatched through the lead/subagent agent runtime tool-call chain (sync wrap_tool_call and async awrap_tool_call).
contracts.protected_resource: The shell execution surface behind the 'bash' tool (sandbox/host shell).
contracts.protection_obligation: Every agent 'bash' tool call must be security-classified before the bash tool handler runs, and commands graded high-risk ('block' verdict) must be rejected with an error ToolMessage so the shell command is never executed; every bash call is audit-logged.
scope_limits: Only tool calls named exactly 'bash' are inspected (sandbox_audit_middleware.py:178-179, 195-196); other tools and non-tool shell surfaces are out of scope.
Medium-risk commands (chmod 777, pip/pip3 install, apt install) execute normally with only an appended warning, not blocked (lines 34-39, 185-187, 202-204).
Detection is regex/shlex pattern matching over the command text; commands not matching the listed patterns are not covered.
